description: Larotrectinib is recommended for use within the Cancer Drugs Fund as an option for treating neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK) fusion-positive solid tumours in adults and children if: the disease is locally advanced or metastatic or surgery could cause severe health problems and they have no satisfactory treatment options. It is recommended only if the conditions in the managed access agreement for larotrectinib are followed.

extensions.name: statement description
extensions.value: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended larotrectinib, within its marketing authorisation, for use within the Cancer Drugs Fund, as a histology-independent treatment option for NTRK fusion-positive solid tumours in adults and children whose disease is locally advanced or metastatic (or where surgery could cause severe health problems) and who have no satisfactory treatment options. Larotrectinib is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the conditions in the managed access agreement for larotrectinib.
